Show and change bronto configuration

```sh
bronto config <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto config get`](/reference/commands/config/#bronto-config-get) | Print one config value |
| [`bronto config list`](/reference/commands/config/#bronto-config-list) | List all config values and where each one comes from |
| [`bronto config set`](/reference/commands/config/#bronto-config-set) | Save a config value to the user config file |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto config get

Print one config value

```sh
bronto config get <key> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto config list

List all config values and where each one comes from

```sh
bronto config list [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto config set

Save a config value to the user config file

```sh
bronto config set <key> <value> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).
